content.text: Digital creators in regions where payment platforms are restricted face a significant barrier: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-cloudflare-r2-digital-21|Everything You]]-you-need-24|building]] a reliable online store. This guide outlines how to create a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages without Stripe or PayPal. You’ll leverage the power of Stack 02, deploying your infrastructure in just 48 hours. By using Cloudflare's technology together with NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-4|COREMERCH guide to payments]], you’ll own your entire process from payment to product delivery, ensuring your sovereignty in digital commerce.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processors often exclude creators in developing regions, leaving them without viable options. COREMERCH addresses this gap by providing a robust infrastructure that enables creators to set up their own stores. With Stack 02, you deploy a system that operates independently of restrictive platforms. This empowers you to maintain full control over your products and earnings while ensuring that payments are seamlessly processed through cryptocurrencies. Such infrastructure not only circumvents limitations but enhances autonomy and reliability, making it ideal for creators who demand sovereignty.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Prior to deployment, you should gather the necessary tools and resources. You will need a Cloudflare account, as well as access to Supabase for database management. Additionally, you must set up a NOWPayments account to handle transactions. Prepare your digital products, ensuring they are ready for upload. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, as it will guide you through the entire setup process. Lastly, ensure your personal or business information is up to date to facilitate smooth operations during and after deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and delivery pipeline is critical for your digital store’s success. Begin by setting up your Cloudflare Pages project, following the detailed instructions in the Sovereign Blueprint. Next, integrate Supabase to manage your product database, allowing both ease of access and organization. Configure NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you select the most suitable blockchain for your needs. With everything in place, test the payment flow to verify that transactions are processed without issues, ensuring that your customers experience seamless interactions.
Own your digital store without reliance on traditional payment processors.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is configured, it’s time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages project and ensure all settings are correctly applied, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email authentication. Announce your store through social media and other channels to attract initial visitors. As customers begin to place orders, monitor your transactions in real-time via NOWPayments. This will not only provide insights into your sales but also help you troubleshoot any potential issues quickly, ensuring a smooth experience for your buyers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your infrastructure is operational, look for opportunities to scale your store. Analyze customer behavior to identify popular products and consider expanding your offerings within Supabase. You can also enhance your marketing efforts by leveraging social media platforms and email campaigns to engage with your audience. Consider using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) if you wish to add more complexity with features like automated order management and advanced analytics. Continuous iteration and improvement will keep your digital store competitive and responsive to market demands.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Deploy your crypto store in just 48 hours with Stack 02.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose which ones best suit your audience's preferences without additional overhead.
